description: Use this when the user asks how a single US stock or ETF has performed or how risky it is: YTD, 1-year and 5-year annualized returns, max drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, beta and alpha, with a 1Y/5Y chart. End-of-day data for US large and mid caps, major foreign stocks and US ETFs. Not for intraday quotes, news, earnings, fundamentals or price targets.

ticker.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, VOO or BRK.B

name: get_security_metrics

asOf.description: Market date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the latest close behind every number

comparisons.description: Popular Redstone comparisons for this ticker

beta1y.description: Versus SPY, from daily returns over the past year

maxDrawdown1yPct.description: Worst peak-to-trough fall over the past year (negative)

sector.description: GICS sector for stocks, category for ETFs

statsSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD, set only when there is less than a year of history: the 1Y figures (return, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, beta, alpha) then run from this first close, and so does the YTD return if it falls this year. Screens on those metrics leave such securities out

title: Get stock or ETF performance and risk
